text.offer: Meidei says, "The sewer men won't go into the deep tunnels any more. Dusk rats, they say, black and quick and hungry. One took a man's hand. Kill ten of them, would you?"
text.progress: Meidei says, "The dusk rats are in the deepest tunnels of the Sewers of Barloque."
text.complete: Meidei says, "Ten of them? The sewer men will drink to you tonight."

steps.objective: Dusk rats slain in the Sewers of Barloque
